title: Lucky Thirteen Maple Syrup Pancake Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lucky Thirteen’s Maple Syrup Pancake brings the classic American diner favourite to delicious life with the warm, buttery batter base drizzled with rich, sweet maple syrup. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend fuses fantastic flavour and cloud production, while the high nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for newer ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
